cards.example_en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
cards.example_zh: 外面的噪音在闹钟响之前就把我吵醒了。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指噪音时不可数；指某个具体声响可用a noise。

cards.example_en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can affect sleep quality and reduce the wellbeing of urban residents.
cards.example_zh: 长期接触交通噪音会影响睡眠质量，降低城市居民的身心健康水平。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She answered my questions in a calm manner.
cards.example_zh: 她平静地回答了我的问题。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“礼貌、礼仪”用复数manners。

cards.example_en: The old gun was displayed behind glass at the museum.
cards.example_zh: 那支旧枪陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。
cards.explain_zh: gun也可指枪状工具，如glue gun（胶枪）。

cards.example_en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
cards.example_zh: 先把纸折成正方形，再剪。
cards.explain_zh: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。

cards.example_en: Community festivals provide an occasion for residents from different backgrounds to share traditions and build friendships.
cards.example_zh: 社区节庆让不同背景的居民有机会分享传统、建立友谊。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“在某次场合”用on，不用in。

cards.example_en: I have met your sister on several occasions.
cards.example_zh: 我见过你姐姐好几次。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I heard a familiar voice outside the kitchen door.
cards.example_zh: 我听见厨房门外传来一个熟悉的声音。
cards.explain_zh: 人熟悉事物用with；事物为人熟悉用to。

cards.example_en: Students who are familiar with digital tools may adapt more easily to online learning environments.
cards.example_zh: 熟悉数字工具的学生可能更容易适应在线学习环境。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please don't ignore that strange noise from the engine.
cards.example_zh: 请别忽视发动机发出的那种怪声。
cards.explain_zh: 直接接宾语；不表示法律上的“驳回诉讼”。

cards.example_en: Uncontrolled urban expansion can destroy natural habitats and threaten the survival of species that depend on them.
cards.example_zh: 不受控制的城市扩张会摧毁自然栖息地，威胁依赖这些栖息地的物种生存。
cards.explain_zh: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。

cards.example_en: The family picnic was a cheerful affair despite the rain.
cards.example_zh: 尽管下着雨，这次家庭野餐仍然很欢乐。
cards.explain_zh: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。

cards.example_en: Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
cards.example_zh: 学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The airport handles both military and civil aircraft.
cards.example_zh: 这座机场既接待军用飞机，也接待民用飞机。
cards.explain_zh: civil law指民法；civil war则指内战。

cards.example_en: Protecting civil rights requires accessible legal services and public institutions that treat all citizens fairly.
cards.example_zh: 保护公民权利需要便捷可及的法律服务，以及公平对待所有公民的公共机构。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Local authorities should locate new health centres near public transport routes to improve access for elderly residents.
cards.example_zh: 地方政府应将新的医疗中心设在公共交通线路附近，以方便老年居民就医。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“位于”常用be located in/near，不直接用locate。

cards.example_en: My aunt became a citizen after living here for years.
cards.example_zh: 我姑妈在这里生活多年后成为了公民。
cards.explain_zh: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。

cards.example_en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
cards.example_zh: 太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。
cards.explain_zh: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

cards.example_en: My grandmother keeps her gold ring in a wooden box.
cards.example_zh: 我奶奶把她的金戒指放在一个木盒里。
cards.explain_zh: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。

cards.example_en: We took a domestic flight to the northern coast.
cards.example_zh: 我们乘坐国内航班去了北部海岸。
cards.explain_zh: 与international相对指国内的；与wild相对指家养的。

cards.example_en: We took a domestic flight to the northern coast.
cards.example_zh: 我们乘坐国内航班去了北部海岸。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The donkey carried a heavy load up the hill.
cards.example_zh: 那头驴驮着沉重的货物上山。
cards.explain_zh: load A with B指把B装进A；卸货用unload。

cards.example_en: The donkey carried a heavy load up the hill.
cards.example_zh: 那头驴驮着沉重的货物上山。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her belief in me helped me try again.
cards.example_zh: 她对我的信心让我愿意再试一次。
cards.explain_zh: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

cards.example_en: A rescue troop reached the village before the storm.
cards.example_zh: 一支救援军队在暴风雨来临前赶到了村子。
cards.explain_zh: 表示士兵常用复数troops；演员团用troupe。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: Governments sometimes deploy troops to deliver emergency supplies when natural disasters make civilian transport systems unusable.
cards.example_zh: 当自然灾害导致民用运输系统无法使用时，政府有时会派遣部队运送应急物资。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We called an engineer to solve the technical problem.
cards.example_zh: 我们请了一位工程师来解决这个技术问题。
cards.explain_zh: technical强调技术或专业知识，不等于高科技。

cards.example_en: Schools should teach technical skills alongside academic subjects to prepare students for a changing workplace.
cards.example_zh: 学校应在教授文化课程的同时传授技术技能，帮助学生适应不断变化的职场。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
cards.example_zh: 出门前请提醒我带伞。
cards.explain_zh: 提醒去做用remind sb to do；使想起用of。

cards.example_en: The alphabetical arrangement made our class list easy to read.
cards.example_zh: 名字按字母排列，我们的班级名单就好读了。
cards.explain_zh: 表示具体筹备常用复数：make arrangements for。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: My skin feels dry after swimming in the pool.
cards.example_zh: 在泳池游泳后，我觉得皮肤很干。
cards.explain_zh: 指人体皮肤通常不可数；一张兽皮可数。

cards.example_en: The old prison has become a popular local museum.
cards.example_zh: 这座旧监狱已成为当地一处受欢迎的博物馆。
cards.explain_zh: in prison指服刑；in the prison强调在监狱内。

cards.example_en: Education programmes in prison can help individuals develop skills that support their successful return to society.
cards.example_zh: 监狱内的教育项目能帮助服刑人员培养技能，支持他们顺利回归社会。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The light switch is just behind the kitchen door.
cards.example_zh: 电灯开关就在厨房门后。
cards.explain_zh: switch on/off表示开关设备；switch to表示改用。

cards.example_en: The light switch is just behind the kitchen door.
cards.example_zh: 电灯开关就在厨房门后。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Work placements allow students to acquire practical skills that are difficult to develop through classroom learning alone.
cards.example_zh: 实习让学生获得仅靠课堂学习难以培养的实用技能。
cards.explain_zh: 比get正式；可接资产，也可接知识、技能。

cards.example_en: My sister handles corporate travel for a small company.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐为一家小公司安排商务差旅。
cards.explain_zh: corporate指企业的；cooperative指合作的。

cards.example_en: The walk home was fairly short and very pleasant.
cards.example_zh: 走路回家的路程还算短，一路也很惬意。
cards.explain_zh: 表程度时弱于very；fairly good是还不错，并非极好。

cards.example_en: Schools should distribute resources fairly so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds receive the support they need.
cards.example_zh: 学校应公平分配资源，让背景不利的学生获得所需的支持。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
cards.example_zh: 这把小椅子完全由实木制成。
cards.explain_zh: 木材义不可数；树林可说a wood或the woods。

cards.example_en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
cards.example_zh: 这把小椅子完全由实木制成。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: All students are encouraged to participate.
cards.example_zh: 鼓励所有学生参与。

cards.example_en: It was a tough climb, but the view was worth it.
cards.example_zh: 这段攀登很艰难，但沿途的风景让付出变得值得。
cards.explain_zh: 读音与rough押韵；形容肉时指难嚼、老。

cards.example_en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
cards.example_zh: 小心别把纸袋撕破了。
cards.explain_zh: 撕裂读/teə/，眼泪读/tɪə/；动词变化为 tore、torn。

cards.example_en: Our class representative asked for more books in the library.
cards.example_zh: 我们班的代表请求为图书馆增添书籍。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词常接of：representative of某群体。

cards.example_en: This small lift has a capacity of six people.
cards.example_zh: 这部小电梯最多能容纳六个人。
cards.explain_zh: 能力用capacity to do；身份用in one's capacity as。

cards.example_en: We crossed the border by train early this morning.
cards.example_zh: 我们今天一早乘火车越过了边境。
cards.explain_zh: border作动词直接接地点；border on还可表示近乎。

cards.example_en: Countries that share a border often need to cooperate closely on trade and environmental protection.
cards.example_zh: 接壤的国家往往需要在贸易和环境保护方面密切合作。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
cards.example_zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。
cards.explain_zh: 不规则变化：shake—shook—shaken。

word.example_en: We called an engineer to solve the technical problem.
word.example_zh: 我们请了一位工程师来解决这个技术问题。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Governments can encourage households to switch to renewable energy by offering financial support.
word.example_zh: 政府可以提供经济支持，鼓励家庭改用可再生能源。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Researchers collected a representative sample of households to investigate changes in energy consumption across the region.
word.example_zh: 研究人员选取了具有代表性的家庭样本，以调查该地区能源消耗的变化。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
